description.zh: 间隔重复背单词：单词 / 音标 / 词性 / 释义 / 例句，四档打分，按天排下次复习
description.en: Spaced repetition for vocabulary: word, IPA, part of speech, meaning and example, four grades, next review scheduled in days

help.zh: 「单词 → 释义」看词猜义；「释义 → 单词」看义想词；「交替」按这张卡的复习次数换边（第 1、3、5 次看单词）。
help.en: Word → meaning guesses the meaning; Meaning → word recalls the word; Alternate flips per review count (1st, 3rd, 5th show the word).

help.zh: 一天里最多放几张没见过的卡进队列。旧卡永远不受这个数限制；填 0 就是只复习、不加新词。
help.en: How many unseen cards may enter the queue in one day. Due reviews are never limited by this; 0 means review only, no new words.

help.zh: 词表里填了音标才显示。关掉之后卡上只留单词、词性和释义，字能放大一点。
help.en: Shown only when the deck has one. Turning it off leaves word, part of speech and meaning, so the text can be larger.

help.zh: 只在翻面之后出。例句长的时候会被省略号截断，鼠标停上去看全句。
help.en: Only on the back of the card. Long examples are cut with an ellipsis; hover to read the whole sentence.

items.zh: 卡片上一开始是空的，点「粘贴词表」把词贴进去，一行一张卡。
items.en: The card starts empty. Press Paste a deck and paste one card per line.

items.zh: 最短写法是「单词 | 释义」；三列时第二列像音标（/…/ 包着）就当音标，否则当词性。
items.en: The shortest form is word | meaning. With three columns the middle one counts as IPA when it looks like /…/, otherwise as the part of speech.

items.zh: 完整写法是「单词 | 音标 | 词性 | 释义 | 例句」，第五列之后都算例句。
items.en: The full form is word | IPA | part of speech | meaning | example; everything after the fifth column is part of the example.

items.zh: 分隔符用竖线或 Tab 都认，前后空格会被去掉；以 # 开头的行当注释跳过。
items.en: Pipes and tabs both separate fields, spaces are trimmed, and lines starting with # are skipped.

items.zh: 同一个单词出现两次只留第一份 —— 重复贴不会把排程冲掉，进度按单词认。
items.en: A repeated word keeps its first entry — re-pasting never resets progress, which is tracked per word.

items.zh: 拿不准格式就先点「塞一份示例」，照着改比对着说明写快。
items.en: Unsure about the format? Press Fill an example and edit that instead of writing from the docs.

items.zh: 点卡片任意位置（或按空格）翻面，再按四个档位之一。
items.en: Click anywhere on the card (or press Space) to flip it, then pick one of the four grades.

items.zh: 键盘 1 / 2 / 3 / 4 对应 重来 / 困难 / 记得 / 容易。
items.en: Keys 1 / 2 / 3 / 4 map to Again / Hard / Good / Easy.

items.zh: 每个按钮下面写着「下次什么时候再来」—— 按下去之前就知道后果。
items.en: Each button shows when the card comes back, so you see the consequence before pressing it.

items.zh: 顶上的计数是「今天还剩几张 / 今天一共做了几张」，不是词表总数。
items.en: The counter is cards left today over cards done today, not the size of the deck.

items.zh: 没见过的新卡：记得 → 1 天后，容易 → 4 天后，困难 → 6 分钟后再来，重来 → 1 分钟后。
items.en: A new card: Good → 1 day, Easy → 4 days, Hard → 6 minutes, Again → 1 minute.

items.zh: 已经在复习的卡：记得就是「现在的间隔 × 这张卡的难度系数」，困难只涨一点，容易再乘 1.3。
items.en: A card under review: Good multiplies the interval by the card's ease, Hard grows it slightly, Easy multiplies again by 1.3.

items.zh: 难度系数从 2.5 起，压到 1.3 就不会再降、抬到 3.0 到顶 —— 一张老是忘的卡不会被压成永远重来。
items.en: Ease starts at 2.5, never drops below 1.3 and never rises above 3.0, so a hard card never collapses into a permanent loop.

items.zh: 复习中按「重来」算一次遗忘：间隔缩回 1 天、难度下调，但今天还会再出现一次。
items.en: Again on a review counts as a lapse: the interval shrinks to 1 day and ease drops, but the card shows up once more today.

items.zh: 间隔最长 3650 天。到了上限就停在那儿，不会溢出成一个奇怪的日期。
items.en: Intervals cap at 3650 days rather than overflowing into a strange date.

items.zh: 词表第三列是词性或标签（v. / n. / 四级 / 考研…），卡上有两个以上不同标签时顶上会出现筛选条。
items.en: The third column is the part of speech or a tag (v. / n. / CET-4 / GRE…). Filter chips appear once there are at least two distinct tags.

items.zh: 筛选只改变「这一轮看哪些卡」，不动排程 —— 没选中的卡照常到期，只是不显示。
items.en: Filtering only changes which cards this round shows; scheduling is untouched, unselected cards still come due.

items.zh: 按组件存，不按这一份实例：桌上摆几个背单词，看到的是同一份词表和同一份进度。
items.en: Stored per widget, not per copy: several Word Drill cards show one deck and one set of progress.

items.zh: 想背第二门外语就换个 id 再装一份 —— 那才是两份独立的数据。
items.en: For a second language, install a copy under a different id; that is what makes the data separate.

items.zh: 写盘失败时标题栏那一格会写「未保存」，鼠标停上去能看到原因，通常是缺存储权限。
items.en: When a write fails the header reads Not saved; hover it for the reason, usually a missing storage permission.

items.zh: 这时卡片照常复习，进度只留在内存里，等能写了再存一次。
items.en: Review keeps working in memory and the next successful write saves it.

changes.zh: 第一个版本：粘贴词表（单词 / 音标 / 词性 / 释义 / 例句），四档打分，按天排下次复习。
changes.en: First release: paste a deck (word / IPA / part of speech / meaning / example), grade with four buttons, schedule the next review by day.

changes.zh: 卡面上直接写「下次什么时候再来」，按下去之前就看得到后果。
changes.en: Each grade shows when the card returns, so the consequence is visible before you press it.

changes.zh: 重新粘贴词表只加新词，已经在背的卡保留原来的间隔和进度。
changes.en: Re-pasting a deck only adds new words; cards already in rotation keep their interval and progress.
